chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Part of a man's happiness is that he is the caretaker of his family.

key_terms.الْقَيِّمَ: the one who manages, maintains, and takes care of affairs
key_terms.الْمَرْءِ: the person or man being addressed in the saying
key_terms.عِيَالِهِ: his dependents and family members under his care

ai.seo_question: How does caring for one’s family relate to a person’s happiness in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person’s happiness is found in responsibly maintaining and managing the affairs of his dependents. It highlights family care and fulfilling one’s domestic responsibilities as a source of well-being and success.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Part of a man's happiness is that he is the caretaker of his family."
